ApprovalProcess.description: FB-V1 benchmark approval process, the target of flow PLS_FB_FL14_Approval_Submit. Deliberately minimal: one step, no entry criteria (the flow owns the gate), no field-update actions — so the observable evidence is the approval mechanism itself (a pending ProcessInstance and the record lock), not approval side effects.
